FORM 10-Q
Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
FakeA Inc. operates in the U.S. and Canada. Revenue rose in Sep. as Gizmo demand held up. Service revenue grew 6% to $1,045 million, helped by No. 2 plant upgrades. Cash and cash equivalents were $2,980 million at September 30, 2026. Is the backlog growing? Yes. Backlog reached $5.1 billion.
